question: Does the surface look work on a domain with no per-site adapter?
method: Fetch under the same robots gate the product uses, then call the generic extractor directly. No bespoke rule for any host below.
per_site_code_size: each admitted site is a 10-line subclass binding a shared engine; the engine is generic_page.py (362 lines) plus product.py (569)

results.title: Allbirds Men's Shoes | Shop Sustainable Footwear for Men

reading: The surface look is site-agnostic and needs no per-site code: two of five unknown domains extracted, one by Open Graph and one by DOM. The other three are honest limits, not defects - two are refused by robots and stay refused, and one returns HTTP 403 to a plain declared user agent, which is not answered by spoofing. Yield on a cold unknown domain is modest and title-and-images shaped; price and size are what the per-site configuration adds.
